title: Local AI controls and translation reliability
privacy: Only existing local loopback backends. No cloud fallback, downloads, or Live Translate changes.

acceptance: Expose which backend/model will actually run and distinguish managed fixed model from external model
Switch models explicitly and verify requests before and after save/reopen on the OCR popup/dashboard paths
Allow saving optional per-task prompts with default/reset behavior and validate size
Reproduce repeated output from a single backend response; remove only provable repeated full translations of single-line input
Preserve intentional repeated lines and formatting on multiline input; test both translation entry points
Keep old settings compatible and reject stale configuration responses
Independent Advisor review of the final diff
Run Windows WebView2 and native loopback-provider regressions, including save/reopen and explicit model change
Only mark checks passed after verified evidence; no merge until review and tests pass
